needs_manual_review_reason: SCOPE CORRECTION APPLIED (2026-07-11 fact-check pass): moved from /data/ to /data/adjacent/. Direct inspection of the live PRIDE record's sampleProcessingProtocol confirms this project's proteomic samples are all M10G cells (an immortalized meningioma cell line) stably expressing pLV APEX2 constructs encoding wildtype or variant Merlin, used for proximity-labeling mass spectrometry; no primary patient tumor tissue was submitted to this PXD accession. The linked paper (PMID 39251601) does include patient MRI and xenograft data, but the mass-spec dataset itself deposited under PXD053578 is cell-line only. Per docs/scope.md ('Cell line, PDX, and organoid meningioma omics data... not patient tissue directly' -> adjacent), this record does not belong in the core inventory; consistent with the precedent already established for cell-line GSE records (gse-174360, gse-199549, gse-210178, gse-273963, gse-282349/282351, gse-307286, gse-309391). Prior note (2026-07-10): the previously-linked PMID 36993679 was only the March 2023 Research Square preprint; PubMed's own 'Update in' cross-reference shows this work was subsequently published as a peer-reviewed article in Nature Communications (PMID 39251601, doi 10.1038/s41467-024-52284-8, 2024 Sep 9, title changed slightly to '...regulates meningioma Wnt signaling...'). The publications entry, date_deposited/date_updated, platform, and license have been filled in/corrected from the live PRIDE record and PubMed; peer_reviewed tag corrected to true accordingly. patient_count/who_edition/brain_invasion/treatment_timepoint_status/anatomic_location_breakdown/tissue_preservation/sex_distribution/age_distribution updated to cell-line-appropriate 'Not applicable' values consistent with this corpus's other adjacent cell-line records.
